expiryWindowDays.description: Legacy Store setting; ignored by v1.2 scoring. Product.expiryPushDays is authoritative

timeZone.description: Must equal the Store calendar zone, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh in this release (decision D4).

lookbackDays.description: Complete calendar days analysed, ending the day before the analysis date. 7..365 inclusive (decision D3, amended 2026-11-02). Omitted: 30 for WEEKLY, 90 for MONTHLY. UI presets: 30, 60, 90, 180.

expiryPushDays.description: Product expiry push threshold in calendar days. Missing or null means 0 (disabled); no Store fallback

stockQuantity.description: Derived sum of inventory batch remainingQuantity values

progressPercent.description: Measured processedCount / totalCount; null when no exact nonzero total is known

RecTransactionEvidence.description: Presence counts from one immutable source dataset; ratios displayed at six decimal places, decisions use exact counts

expiryDate.description: Optional unless the product requires expiry tracking

minUtilValue.description: Positive value, at most 6 decimal places; PERCENTAGE in (0,100], ABSOLUTE in frozen weighted utility units

expiryScore.description: Current shared F03 expiry score; unknown required metadata may yield null

weightValue.description: Current Backend Weight preview, not a frozen historical Weight. Null when ready=false

ready.description: Whether a valid current Weight can be calculated; not proof of sellable inventory

supportCount.description: Not measured by SPMF; always null

failureMessage.description: Actionable final cause of a FAILED occurrence (decision D7); null otherwise.

skipReason.description: Set only for SKIPPED: a missed fire time superseded by a later one (decision D6).

expiringSoonQuantity.description: Sellable quantity expiring strictly after today through the inclusive lookahead date
